nodes.description: Public address state variable holding the contract owner, initialized to msg.sender at deployment time; used as the authorization anchor.
Public uint state variable recording the last completed migration index; written by setCompleted.
Public function setCompleted(uint completed) guarded by the restricted modifier; writes the caller-supplied value into last_completed_migration.
Access-control modifier that requires msg.sender == owner before the modified function body executes.
Caller-controlled address used both to initialize owner and to authorize setCompleted through the restricted modifier.
Caller-supplied uint parameter of setCompleted that is stored into last_completed_migration.
State-mutating assignment last_completed_migration = completed; privileged because it is reachable only when msg.sender equals owner.

edges.reason: msg.sender is copied into the owner state variable during construction, establishing the privileged account from an external input.
The restricted modifier compares the untrusted msg.sender against owner and reverts unless the caller is the owner.
The restricted modifier gates execution of setCompleted, so caller identity determines whether the function body runs.
Execution of setCompleted reaches the state-mutating assignment of last_completed_migration.
The completed parameter value flows directly into the unsafe state write operation.
The completed parameter is stored into the last_completed_migration state variable.

normalization_plan.reason: The completed parameter only exists inside setCompleted and flows directly into the guarded state write, so it can be normalized into the enclosing function abstraction.
